requiredFindings.title: Charge the descent before opening or duplicating its directory descriptor
requiredFindings.detail: Both walks perform part of the descent before enter() charges descend_cost. measure starts by evaluating dup(self.dir...) at line 1006 and opens each child at 1018; remove_bounded does the same at 1044 and 1053. The charge occurs only inside enter at 1218, after its OwnedFd argument has already been created. This violates LD-D3A-12 and the published descend_cost contract that every directory open/duplicate is charged before it occurs. For example, an objects=1 ledger cannot fund the initial objects=3 descent, yet fcntl(F_DUPFD_CLOEXEC) still executes. At a nested descent with insufficient remaining work, openat still executes; an EACCES/EMFILE can even return Operation(Io) before the budget refusal is reached. The current Descend log is emitted after the charge and after the earlier open, so successful-run charge equality and the uncharged-status mutant do not detect this ordering defect.
requiredFindings.requiredChange: Reserve the complete descent cost before the initial dup and every child open in both walks, charging exactly once. Put the effect inside the charged helper (or pass it as a closure) so an OwnedFd is not produced before the guard. Preserve errno-bearing failures for funded I/O attempts. Add call-site observations for openat/fcntl and controls with insufficient initial and nested-descent budget, proving Budget is returned with no unfunded open/duplicate attempted; include a late-charge mutation or equivalent ordering control.
